propositions: bidirectional reconciliation against a realistic store copy must be proven live with issue creation inbound and local edit outbound, each asserting round-trip on the instance
the working repo must be isolated with zero git remotes, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and no Cloud credentials, asserted by tests that fail the job otherwise
the store copy must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* artifacts and production jira bindings, with completeness asserted by enumerating the copied tree not by hardcoded lists
a scrubbed store over an unscoped pass must plan zero deletions and zero outbound updates, read from dry-run JSON envelope keys, proving no phantom mutations from leftover bindings
fourteen inbound and fourteen outbound mutations must each round-trip through their respective oracles on the instance, scoped per-mutation via --filter-local-ids to prevent mass spurious creates
pagination must be observed at runtime to discover the instance's effective page size, then seeded 2*observed+1 issues to force multiple pages, with full recovery asserted by plan-entry intersection
